description: This Zenodo release describes an integrated electricity and hydrogen energy community in Porsgrunn, Norway. It selects hourly 2024 electricity-demand profiles for 400 residential, commercial and industrial users; the article describes a January–September observation span. The community configuration assumes rooftop PV for 300 users and batteries for 250, alongside a 1.3-megawatt wind turbine whose generation profile is simulated from weather. The latest version 3 adds a hydrogen-bus yearly workbook to the energy-community workbook. Zenodo makes both public under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one constructed community case, not a measured complete hydrogen distribution network or a random sample of Norwegian towns. Real meter profiles, assumed distributed assets, simulated wind output and modeled prices must be kept distinct. A reviewer-assessed use is testing local dispatch or electricity-hydrogen coupling in energy-system simulations. model-pypsa is a related planning tool, but no direct dataset conversion or validated network model is claimed. The Data in Brief article cited an earlier version; no workbook was downloaded.
